svg.title: DDP compression: fewer bytes do not guarantee a shorter step
svg.desc: An isometric patch-panel metaphor: full matrix cards, two slim factor cards and an equally important residual drawer. Synthetic analytical estimates, not GPU measurements.

g.text: A smaller wire payload is only one part of the training step.
Shared P/Q factors need two reductions; residual feedback needs a gradient-sized ledger.
Full matrix cards → factor cards + residual drawer
Gate 1 · shape saving Gate 2 · exposed time Gate 3 · matched training quality
E(next) = G + E − reconstruction. Feedback is an accounting identity, not a convergence guarantee.
FP32 baseline · ideal Ring · assumed codec/overlap · no FSDP claim · no physical GPU measurements
